name: vine-turtle

canvasPlacement.registration: Uniform whole-canvas resize of accepted idle first cell retains all original transparent margins; every frame shares this registration.

method: Rendered original continuous weighted mesh with hierarchical local bone articulation and drawn closed-eyelid attachment swaps. The original body surfaces retain their design and palette. In-plane collapse exposes no hidden contours. No global fade or whole-image squash.
rootMotion: Intentional body descent during collapse; toe contacts remain near their original locations.
previewLoop: The preview repeats for inspection; runtime death is non-looping and holds the settled pose.
